title: Smart Salon — Publish current site on Internet Computer

requirements.summary: Prepare the current frontend for a successful ICP publish using the existing deployment process and ensure the live canister URL(s) can be obtained and shared for preview.
acceptanceCriteria: A successful deploy is performed for the current codebase (frontend and backend canisters as applicable).
The resulting live canister URL(s) are provided (at minimum, the frontend canister URL suitable for sharing and previewing in a browser).
The deployed site loads successfully at the provided URL and renders the Smart Salon landing page without runtime errors.

file_operations.description: Expand and finalize the deployment guide so it clearly documents the existing ICP deployment process and where to retrieve the resulting live canister URL(s) for sharing/preview. Reference the existing deployment scripts/templates provided by the selected github-export-icp-cli component and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add the Smart Salon logo asset to the frontend public assets directory so the landing page header image referenced in frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx resolves correctly after deployment (ICP asset serving).
Ensure the generated favicon file exists at this exact path so the link tag in frontend/index.html loads correctly after deployment.
Ensure the generated apple-touch-icon file exists at this exact path so the link tag in frontend/index.html loads correctly after deployment.
